verdict.rationale: Ironclad offers e-signature: a 'Sign Contracts' product page, an embeddable Ironclad Signature experience, and bring-your-own signature provider routing. However, nothing in the evidence documents setting signing order, automatic reminders, or expirations on outstanding signature requests. Signature capability alone does not establish these specific controls.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can set signing order, automatic reminders, and expirations on outstanding signature requests
